integrity: The proof is self-contained: convexity of the complement excludes spine vertices, forces internal page vertices to occur in pairs, and general position forbids two selected pages. The converse follows because entering a selected page creates a three-edge detour across a one-edge spine. A standalone checker independently evaluates the defining shortest-path condition for every subset in the tested range.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to square-page book graphs with at least two pages.
The boundary graph B_1 = C_4 has additional dual general position pairs and is excluded.
No claim is made for triangular books, longer-cycle books, or arbitrary generalized theta graphs.
Finite exhaustive verification over 2 <= r <= 9 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed refinement of the generalized-theta result.
title: Dual general position sets of book graphs
